_script: Max: Cereal is food floating in liquid in a bowl, so cereal is soup.
Gpa: Soup is hot, and nobody eats soup for breakfast.
title: The Great Cereal Question
claim: Cereal is food floating in liquid in a bowl, so cereal is soup.
relief: The court declares that cereal is soup.
